title: artemisia camphorata var. peduncularis
intro: Artemisia camphorata var. peduncularis, commonly known as Southernwood, is a perennial herbaceous plant native to the Mediterranean region and parts of Asia. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Southernwood include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant effects, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of Southernwood include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
